steps.en: Summons numbers and court number are filled in automatically
steps.id: Summons number dan court number terisi otomatis
steps.why_en: No AOS screen exists to receive these values.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar AOS untuk menerima nilai ini.

steps.en: The officer's name and designation are filled in automatically
steps.id: Nama dan designation officer terisi otomatis
steps.why_en: The login token has no designation and nothing builds an AOS from it.
steps.why_id: Token login tidak punya designation dan tidak ada yang menyusun AOS darinya.

steps.en: Today's date is filled in as the preparation date
steps.id: Tanggal hari ini terisi sebagai tanggal persiapan
steps.why_en: No AOS form exists to hold the preparation date.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form AOS untuk memuat tanggal persiapan.

steps.en: Date served and registered article numbers appear on screen
steps.id: Date served dan registered article number tampil di layar
steps.why_en: These fields are not stored or shown anywhere in the system.
steps.why_id: Field ini tidak disimpan atau ditampilkan di mana pun dalam sistem.

steps.en: The details are shown in the AOS template layout
steps.id: Detail tampil dalam tata letak template AOS
steps.why_en: No AOS template exists anywhere in the repos.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada template AOS di repo mana pun.

steps.en: The officer reviews and confirms the filled-in details
steps.id: Officer memeriksa dan mengonfirmasi detail yang terisi
steps.why_en: There is no confirmation screen for an AOS.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar konfirmasi untuk AOS.

steps.en: The officer signs the AOS electronically
steps.why_en: No electronic signing exists; only login token checks.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penandatanganan elektronik; hanya pengecekan token login.
